request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Intersect governance coordination, technical stewardship, incident response, release coordination, and management of critical unowned processes for June 2026 to June 2027.

claims.claim: Intersect requests 25,400,000 ADA, with the on-chain reward value stated as 25,400,000,000,000 lovelace to the listed 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address.

The proposal says Intersect’s 2026-2027 core operating model supports governance coordination, critical unowned processes, technical stewardship, incident response, and release coordination for Cardano.

The budget is divided into 6,000,000 ADA for operations and ecosystem coordination, 18,800,000 ADA for technical stewardship and incident response, and 600,000 ADA for management of critical processes.
Intersect states its ask has reduced from $7.875M last year to $6.35M this year while preserving the most critical continuity and maturity functions.
Intersect claims it has coordinated two network upgrades, is preparing for a third, and led ecosystem coordination during the November 2025 chain partition incident.

The proposal says it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting documentation, final audited results, and an audit report.
The proposal states the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission and links to the relevant governance action.
The proposal discloses that Intersect and its committees received 22,385,000 ADA from three listed Cardano Treasury governance actions within the past 24 months.

The proposal says independent audits and assurance will be provided by Appold, covering possible deliverable verification, control testing, spend validation, and milestone evidence review where appropriate.

Intersect says it will use Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, multisignature-style administrative permissions, named oversight entities, and public dashboard tracking.

summary: The document requests 25,400,000 ADA for Intersect’s 2026-2027 governance coordination and technical stewardship work, gives a work-package budget, on-chain destination details, prior funding disclosures, voting-process references, and smart-contract oversight information.
